Dear 2 MRs and IOG catalyst admin,
Here is the update as requested.
・IOG catalyst discussion's email thread: (Since Nov'24)--> We got discussion/zoom calls/and the aligned action plan --> Transaction TX provided to achieve the committed KPI in the original proposal --> Please refer to column H in the Gsheet (in Yellow highlight) >> ROW 41-71 for the 5 new campaigns with transactions ID) 
・Proof of achievement: Please refer to Column E in the Gsheet (highlighted in Yellow) => (*) Note: Please keep in mind the flow of release funds for NPOs. 
・Transaction from C4G funding (onchain) >> ONUS CEX Account (Cardano4Good) (Provided)>> Release to the Local NPOS (via the ONUS ID (CEX) off-chain) (*) the ONUS Team manage the treasury (in ADA/USDT/VNDC/ONUS coins, and they will decide how to cash out to local NPOs.)
・>> (Because the local NPOs are not familiar with cryptocurrency, each of them needs to open a CEX account (ONUS ID) and receive via their local bank accounts.)
・The # of campaigns instead of #3, we delivered #9 campaigns + 2 pilot campaigns to deliver the commitment. Please see the campaign page (our efforts from Nov'24-Mar'25)

Additionally, the mandatory close-out procedure (PCR and PCV) as the Catalyst guideline. 
・NEW Close-Out Video (public link) 
・NEW Close-Out Report

After all, we appreciate your time and effort, and we hope to close this out as per the promise/reputation with Catalyst community.
With appreciation
Cardano4Good team.
